# Hypermaps.world

> A playful, human-first map that resonates with who you are. Explore many worlds, follow your friends' taste, and find your vibe.

Hypermaps.world is a pitch deck and concept site for a community-curated mapping experience. It presents the product vision through an interactive horizontal slide deck: personas, information decay, many worlds, how it works, ask-the-area, pin context, competition, and vision.

## Pages

- [Pitch deck](/): Interactive horizontal slide deck explaining Hypermaps.world — many worlds, living layers, community curation.
